title: Our House Has Nine Rooms For FOUR 🗝️
description:
Here, your house builds a room for everyone who's ever lived in it. Newlyweds move into two rooms. The boarding house on the hill is a whole block long.

Ours has nine rooms, and there are four of us. Mom keeps five of them shut, and nobody will say whose they are.

It's made up. A blocky story, built with code and Blender.
pin: Comment ROOM if your house would need a few more.
